Solutions · Solution 05

Make different systems work as one operating environment.

Institutional technology rarely lives in one system. ERP, banking applications, payment platforms, government systems, billing tools and legacy applications often need to exchange information continuously. Hamerkop designs integration environments that connect those systems through defined, monitored interfaces.

Scope

Enterprise Integration

Integration work covers API management, integration platforms, government interoperability, legacy modernization, monitoring, observability and service-level management around connected systems.

Designed for

  • Organizations running multiple critical platforms
  • Institutions modernizing legacy systems without replacing everything at once
  • Government environments requiring interoperability
  • Businesses connecting ERP, banking, payment, billing and operational applications

Key capabilities

Enterprise Integration

API architecture

Controlled interfaces govern how systems and data services communicate.

System connectors

Applications across different vendors and technology environments operate through managed integrations.

Legacy integration

Extend the value of existing systems while new platforms are introduced.

Interoperability

Institutional systems exchange information through defined structures and interfaces.

Monitoring

Monitoring provides visibility into integration health and service behavior.

Operational documentation

Runbooks and service-level documentation support long-term operation and ownership.
